about: For each skill with an eval suite under .claude/evals/<skill>/: the digest of the skill and its suite at the last decision, and whether the eval ran (with scores) or was skipped (with the reason and who decided). pnpm check:skill-evals fails when the digest changes. The eval costs money, so the developer decides: run it, or record a skip. Reasoning: aimeat/scripts/check-skill-evals.ts.

aimeat-writing.note: language-context rows only: settlement, daily ceiling and settlements a day (federation peer, Jouni 2026-11-01), kuvasääntö and syväväärennös, and the OpenRouter region row, merged; no instruction changed; Jouni skipped each, 2026-10-31 and 2026-11-01

aimeat-ai-capabilities.note: one added refusal code (SCOPE_DENIED for a private input the run may not read), no change to the skill's guidance; Jouni skipped evals for the secaudit wave 3 round, 2026-10-22
